documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Approval Of Financial Results For The Period Ended On 30Th September 2026
Financial Results For The Period Ended On 30Th September, 2026
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Financial Result For Quarter And Half Year Ended On 30Th September, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011

analysis.summary: Management reported that the company's current order book stands at around 115 to 116 crores, with consistent inquiries across various industry segments. Despite experiencing a slowdown in shipments during the first two quarters due to client-side delays and boiler maintenance, the company expects the overall 2024-2025 results to match those of the preceding year. Management is actively expanding its product portfolio with innovations like the Smart Rod system, Ion Exchange Membranes, and advanced evaporation systems to drive future growth. Additionally, the food division continues to target steady year-on-year growth and aims to achieve higher capacity utilization over the next three years. Management stated that the company is experiencing a good year overall, driven by strong demand across several engineering and food segments, though future slowness and intense competition remain key concerns.

guidance.claim: The company expects that for the financial year 2024-25, it will be able to match, if not exceed, the results of the preceding year 2023-24.
guidance.quote: However, we expect that for the financial year 2024-25, we will be able to match, if not exceed, the results of the preceding year 2023-24.

guidance.claim: The top line is expected to grow by around 15% compared to last year, with the bottom line more or less in line with that.
guidance.quote: What is the outlook for year 23-24 in terms of top line and bottom line? So, the top line is expected to see a growth of around 15% compared to last year when the bottom line will also be more or less in line with that.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted a certain degree of slowness or return in the speed of inquiries and incoming projects for the future.
demand_outlook.quote: But I am not very sure about the future because there is a certain degree of slowness or return in the speed of the inquiries or in the speed of the projects that are coming up.

demand_outlook.claim: The export market tends to be very volatile, giving constant unpredictability in dollar price fluctuations and access to banking systems in African countries.
demand_outlook.quote: The export market has been volatile. I think there was a question about the outlook for exports- the US and UK has picked up, which was substantially lower last year, but then again, we have instances like Sudan where there has been unrest and one of our largest customers in Sudan. So, the export market tends to be very volatile, giving us constant unpredictability, whether it is in dollar, price fluctuations, whether it is in African countries being able to access their dollar or the banking system etc., etc.

demand_outlook.claim: The Middle East is becoming very serious about going in for zero liquid discharge (ZLD).
demand_outlook.quote: About evaporators, we just received news that Middle East is now going for ZLD i.e., zero liquid discharge. The entire Middle East is very serious about going in for ZLDs.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that consumer demand remained steady, reflecting a balance between spending on premium products and seeking value for money.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumer demand remained steady, although purchasing behaviour reflected a balance between spending on premium products and seeking value for money.

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported that demand for packaged, convenience, ready-to-cook, and value-added food products continued to strengthen due to various factors.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for packaged, convenience, ready-to-cook, and value-added food products continued to strengthen, driven by rising disposable incomes, expanding organised retail, e-commerce penetration, and increasing health and wellness awareness among consumers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has land available where it can immediately start building a facility that could add another Rs. 20 Crores if the need arises.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we have a factory which we can immediately built, which we can immediately start. That could add another Rs. 20 Crores if the need arises.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has a very large chunk of land next to the food division to start a large factory if there is a huge surge.
capex_expansion.quote: And most importantly, we have got a very large chunk of land next to the food division, which at all. If there is a huge surge we can put in a good amount of capital and can start a large factory over there

capex_expansion.claim: The food division resumed all production at its new facility starting March this year without any more teething issues.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year, as we have finally now resumed all our production at our new facility, we are now kink free in the sense that we don't have any more teething issues. We sort of went into full-fledged production starting March this year

capex_expansion.claim: The engineering division does not envisage going in for expansion capex for the next 2-3 years because it can scale up to dispatch 250 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we do not envisage going in for expansion Capex at least as far as the Engineering division is concerned for the next 2-3 years, because we can really scale up to, we did a thorough study and we think that we can do a dispatch of 250 crores. As far as only the Engineering division is concerned.

margins_costs.claim: Evaporators are used for recovering water from industrial effluent, resulting in lower profitability compared to vacuum systems.
margins_costs.quote: While there is notable growth in the evaporator division, it's important to note that evaporators are used for recovering water from industrial effluent (waste water), which results in lower profitability compared to vacuum systems.

margins_costs.claim: Competition from indigenous and overseas manufacturers is increasing intensely, creating a price war and keeping margins under pressure.
margins_costs.quote: How is the competition where the competition is very, very severe? This is one of the reasons why we are really we have to pull up our sleeves. Day by day competition of indigenous manufacturers as well as overseas manufacturers, is increasing. Competition is becoming very intense. It is almost like a price war going on. Margins are under pressure always

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that food segment profit before tax increased to Rs. 4.03 crores, representing an improvement of over 34% compared with FY2024-25.
margins_costs.quote: segment profit before tax increased to Rs. 4.03 crores, representing an improvement of over 34% compared with FY2024–25.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that inflation moderated significantly during the year, averaging around 2% to 3%.
margins_costs.quote: Inflation moderated significantly during the year, averaging around 2%–3%, aided by easing food and fuel prices and stable core inflation.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently has around 115 to 116 crores in orders on hand.
orders_capacity.quote: In total, we currently have around ₹115 to ₹116 crores in orders on hand.

orders_capacity.claim: Current order booking is almost in the same vicinity as it was last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current order booking usually varies from the amounts that you knew last time and this year also it is the AutoZone end is more or less constant. Though it should increase with the more dispatches that we have done last year. So, we are in the process of increasing our orders on hand, but it is almost in the same vicinity as it was last year.

orders_capacity.claim: The market share in vacuum systems in the Indian market is about 30 to 35%, and in evaporators for ZLD it is about 8 to 10%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, as I have told you that in vacuum systems our market share is somewhere about 30 to 35% as far as the Indian market is concerned and Evaporators for ZLD or zero liquid discharge for, mainly for effluent, we have market share about 8 to 10%.

orders_capacity.claim: The engineering division order book is safe enough for one year, providing enough safety without sharing specific numbers.
orders_capacity.quote: as far as the order book is concerned, we don't share the numbers as such, but it is considerably good to make us from there, we will not like to share the numbers but as far as the current year order book is concerned, it is safe enough for one year.

orders_capacity.claim: The Engineering Division recorded a 12.66% increase in turnover over the previous financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: The Engineering Division recorded a 12.66% increase in turnover over the previous financial year, while its profit increased by 15.69%, reflecting sustained demand and improved operational performance.

orders_capacity.claim: The Food Division reported a 2.84% slight decline in turnover compared to the previous financial year.
orders_capacity.quote: The Food Division reported a 2.84% slight decline in turnover compared to the previous financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is debt-free and can go in for working capital borrowings at a later stage if required.
capital_allocation.quote: if at all there may be some required right now, we are debt free. We can go in for borrowings for working capital at the later stage. But right now, we don't feel the need.

capital_allocation.claim: Management noted that Mazda has maintained its stable capital structure with virtually zero long-term borrowings as of 31st March, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Mazda has maintained its stable capital structure with virtually zero long-term borrowings as of 31st March, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company proposed a final dividend of Rs. 4.00 per equity share of face value of Rs. 02 each for the financial year ended on 31st March, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: To declare Final Dividend of Rs. 4.00 per equity share of face value of Rs. 02 each for the financial year ended on 31st March, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Direct exports have not grown because multinational procurement centers and clients purchase through Indian operations to secure lower prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: everyone now knows it and that is why direct Export have not really grown. As far as Croll-Reynolds are concerned, they were doing very good business in Europe and other countries. But as you know that Europe is not doing well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Europe is not doing well economically, affecting exports to that region.
risks_headwinds.quote: As far as Croll-Reynolds are concerned, they were doing very good business in Europe and other countries. But as you know that Europe is not doing well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that businesses faced challenges from fluctuations in commodity prices, freight costs, and currency exchange rates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Businesses also faced challenges from fluctuations in commodity prices, freight costs, and currency exchange rates, which continued to affect operating costs and overall business performance across industries.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that rising energy prices, supply chain disruptions, and continued geopolitical tensions in West Asia remain key external risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, rising energy prices, supply chain disruptions, and continued geopolitical tensions in West Asia remain key external risks.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch the Ion Exchange Membrane product in about a year.
management_commitments.quote: We plan to launch this product in about a year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to launch high gravity-based equipment in 2027.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to launch it in 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to achieve an annual turnover of 60 crore within three years in the food division.
management_commitments.quote: With everything in place, we aim to achieve annual turnover of ₹ 60 Crore within three years, which would be the full capacity.

management_commitments.claim: Management does not envisage going in for expansion capex for the engineering division for the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we do not envisage going in for expansion Capex at least as far as the Engineering division is concerned for the next 2-3 years

management_commitments.claim: Percy Avari's personal focus for the next 2 or 3 years is on trying to increase the bottom line with the help of new products.
management_commitments.quote: at least for the next 2 or 3 years my personal focus really on trying to increase our bottom line by the help of this these new products.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an intention to increase the distribution network in Gujarat to 40 distributors over the next couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: In Gujarat, our distribution network comprises 26 distributors, and we aim to increase this to 40 distributors over the next couple of months.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
